metadata.title: Higher order unknotting numbers for knots and links
metadata.abstract: Ohyama, Taniyama and Yamada showed that finite type knot invariants are insensitive to the unknotting number: for any integer n and any knot K, there is an unknotting number 1 knot which cannot be distinguished from K by any finite type invariant of order $\le n$. We generalize this result in three directions. First, we prove an analogous result for all higher order unknotting number given by $C_n$-moves. Second, we give several extensions to the link case. Third, we show that a similar result holds for ribbon 2-knots.
metadata.comment: 18 pages; no AI tools were used at any stage

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 高阶 unknotting 数与有限型不变量的失明性
analysis.workSummary: 推广有限型结不变量不能识别通常 unknotting 数的既有现象：建立由 C_n 变换定义的各阶 unknotting 数的对应结果，给链环情形多种扩展，并证明 ribbon 2-knots 的类似结论。
analysis.breakthrough: 展示有限阶分类信息对多种解结复杂度均有系统性局限。
analysis.limitations: 具体量词及不变量阶数与 C_n 阶数的关系未在摘要给出；不能由有限阶不可区分推断所有不变量相同或结同胚。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
